summary.text: HAFSLUND KRAFT INNLANDET AS (887 396 752), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2004-10-01; address Industrigata 45, 2619 LILLEHAMMER, Norge. Main industry is Production of electricity from hydropower (35.121); 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Stig Morten Løken; Board chair: Kristin Lian; Auditor: DELOITTE AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 4.07 bn, operating profit NOK 3.22 bn, net profit NOK 1.22 bn, equity NOK 5.22 bn, total assets NOK 11.79 bn. The registry lists the website https://www.hafslund.no, but its content could not be verified.

statements.text: Works in production of electricity from hydropower (industry code 35.121). CEO: Stig Morten Løken; Chair: Kristin Lian.
Filed accounts for 2025: revenue NOK 4.07 bn, net result NOK 1.22 bn, equity NOK 5.22 bn. The year ended with a profit.
